input.summary: Ported fuzz.cu to fuzz.cpp in plain SYCL 2020. It has no dpct headers, helpers or macros, and it compiles with add_dpct_include=false. The kernel is a 1-D parallel_for over USM buffers, and the queue is in-order with profiling enabled to report kernel_ms. I ran it on a generated 48 kHz mono test tone against build/reference. The two outputs differ by at most 1.2e-7 per sample, and the difference RMS is about -151 dBFS, well under the -96 dBFS bar and the 1e-5 absolute tolerance. I only tested that one synthetic input, with the default drive and gain.
